sources.summary: De Montfort University design graduate Safaa Fojdar has developed a prototype for a portable device that uses suction to remove wrinkles from garments on the go. The cordless device, called Elide, features a vacuum-style nozzle attachment that funnels warm air onto the clothing, while gentle suction removes light creases at a skin-safe maximum temperature of The post Elide dewrinkler allows users to smooth out clothes while wearing them appeared first on Dezeen .
